description: [African Arguments] On 25 March 2026, a high-level interagency coordination meeting took place at Ukraine's Presidential Office, chaired by Kyrylo Budanov. The subject was the expansion of Ukraine's presence on the African continent -- and it was the first such meeting in the country's history at this level. Priority countries have been identified. Coordination mechanisms agreed. A draft action plan has been submitted to the Cabinet of Ministers. The priority regions are the Maghreb and Sub-Saharan Africa.

description: [The Conversation Africa] Who counts as an intellectual? In many traditions, the figure of the intellectual is tied to the search for truth, social critique and public engagement.
